## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes locally.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behaviour changes.
- [ ] I updated the README, docstrings or FAQ where needed.
- [ ] No cookies, tokens, `.env` files or private URLs are included.
- [ ] The change works on Windows and Linux, or the limitation is explained.
- [ ] Media is still streamed and never written to disk by the app.
